Name: Octopus Refresh
Author: queenkaelin
Description: I've always thought the vanilla octopus sprite looked odd. To me it always seemed like a squid, what with it's longer and thinner head and only half the arms octopuses usually have (yes, that IS the correct plural of the word. Short answer is because Latin is an odd language), so I decided to fix it! I've put out my own spin on how the octopus looks. I toyed around with the idea of recoloring it pink, red, or even purple, but I left it orange. Maybe I could add an update to toggle colors? And change it's cost to be actually worth the trouble of catching it. Perhaps an update may come to add that! Though I likely only will if I get enough interest sooooo let me know! :D

Downloads.Description: Revamp your octopuses with this brand spankin' new mod!

Manifest.Name: Octopus-Refresh
Manifest.Description: Changes the look of the octopus
